lines.en: I roll a step, then halt.
Square as I am, I cannot walk straight.
My six faces take turns leading.
Walking is a compromise for me.
I tip over a block and land dull.
My corner lands first.
Rolling suits me better than walking.
My edges rotate as I move.

lines.zh: 地面被我的棱切了一下
lines.en: The ground gets cut by my edge.
I tip and tumble toward you.
Each face I turn, the world changes once.
I leave no prints, only squares.

lines.zh: 我是一块不该在这的立方
lines.en: I am a cube that should not be here.

lines.zh: 六个面都朝着不同方向
lines.en: All six faces point somewhere.
I quietly occupy volume.

lines.zh: 我的棱比我的面更真实
lines.en: My edges feel more real than my faces.
Can you count my corners?
At rest I look most like a prop.

lines.zh: 我的影子是规整的方形
lines.en: My shadow is a tidy square.

lines.zh: 我转了一点点，你没看见
lines.en: I rotated slightly; you missed it.
The world is one block short.
I am uneven, but orderly.
My weight sits somewhere inside.
I am waiting for the next frame.
I am in the corner, always.
My faces are starting to look old.
One of my faces is toward you.

lines.zh: 你从哪一面看我都一样
lines.en: I look the same from every side.
You turn; I need not.

lines.zh: 我在你的视野里保持方正
lines.en: I stay square inside your view.

lines.zh: 你在找我哪一面是正面
lines.en: You are guessing which face is my front.
My edge lines point at you.
The longer you look, the squarer I get.
My gaze has no direction.
You suspect I am watching; you are right.

lines.zh: 我不需要眼睛也能被看见
lines.en: I need no eyes to be seen.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的方格切开
lines.en: My square cuts across your shadow.
I hold still; you circle around.
Every face of mine has a seam.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我记住角度了
lines.en: You are looking; I noted the angle.

lines.zh: 站远点，才能看清我是方的
lines.en: Step back to see that I am square.
My color is slightly off.
When you look, do not look too long.
My faces are swallowing light.
Count my corners; one is missing.

lines.zh: 我对着你，像一扇没开的门
lines.en: I face you like an unopened door.
One of my corners dented.

lines.zh: 你打掉了我的一块方皮
lines.en: You knocked off a square of my skin.
I do not yell; cubes do not yell.
I turned half a circle to steady myself.
That must have hurt your hand.
I lost a piece, still square.
The crack follows my edge.
The hit left me slightly crooked.
Not the seams, please.
A small piece rolled away from me.
You set the food before me.
All six faces smell it.
I touch it with an edge.
I have no mouth, only seams.
You step back and leave the food.
Beside me it looks so soft.
I want to make it square.
I feel only curiosity toward food.
You feed me to keep me quiet.
I go around it, still watching you.
You hit my edge.

lines.zh: 我翻倒了，又自己正过来
lines.en: I toppled, then righted myself.
Two cubes collide cleanly.
My corner met your knee.
You were knocked back half a step.
There is no soft part on me.

lines.zh: 我们的影子重叠成方的
lines.en: Our shadows overlapped into a square.
After the hit I spun in place.
You heard a hollow knock.
Our edges did not line up.

lines.zh: 两块方的东西也凑不到一起
lines.en: Two square things still do not fit.
I can only stack on myself.

lines.zh: 没有配偶，只有同样的我
lines.en: No mate, only the same me.
I align my edges against the wall.
Come close and you will turn square.
I try to pair with my shadow.
Breed? I would rather copy.
There should be only one cube here.
I turn half a turn, as an answer.
With two of me, one is surplus.
I press down on what you dropped.
My corner has it wedged.
I do not take it; I cover it.
It vanished under me.
While you bent down, I turned a face.
I take it into my volume.
This thing is square now.
Take it and a square mark remains.
I hold it for no reason.
Picking up needs hands; I have none.
I aim one face at you.
You are inside my frame now.
My edges swivel toward you.
Locking on needs no eyes.
You fit neatly on one of my faces.
Found you, in this very square.
I begin tipping your way.

lines.zh: 你被我的体积注意到了
lines.en: My mass has noticed you.
I reach you without speeding up.
You are dead ahead, very square.
I turned this face for you.

lines.zh: 你听见棱线划地的声音
lines.en: Hear my edges scrape the floor?
Stay still; I can still roll over.
The square has closed on you.
I chose you without reason.
Do not stand in my rolling path.
I tip forward, block by block.
My path is a zigzag.

lines.zh: 你在前面，我滚得慢但不停
lines.en: You are ahead; I roll slow but never stop.
My corners knock on the floor.
You turn; I turn too, clumsily.
I roll at your feet.
Each tumble brings me closer.
There is a square hole in your door.
I am stuck in the doorframe.
Wait until I turn this face over.
I do not go around; I press through.
You are upstairs; I am looking for stairs.
The floor shakes; it is me.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离是直角
lines.en: The distance between us is a right angle.
You run faster than a cube.
I see it: your back.
You hid in a narrow pass; I cannot fit.
I will wait outside.
You will come out eventually.
I have squared off the exit.
I bring my edge down.
A perfectly square blow.
I topple onto you.
This is a crush, not a punch.
My corner reached you first.
My edge pushes you to the wall.
I do not swing; I fall.
Weight works better than muscle.
You covered your head; wise.

lines.zh: 我的棱在你护甲上滑开
lines.en: My edge slid off your armor.
I land with a heavy thud.

lines.zh: 你退开两格，我重新站起
lines.en: You back off two blocks; I rise again.
This face is not well practiced.
I crushed the floor by your feet.
The next face will be heavier.
I cannot crush twice in a row.
A square thing has landed.

lines.zh: 我从地板的格子里冒出来
lines.en: I rise out of the floor's grid.
The world gained one square.
You heard a very dull thud.
I appeared not quite upright.
This corner is one brick short.

lines.zh: 我从方块堆里被挤出来
lines.en: I was squeezed out of the block pile.

lines.zh: 加载时我被放错了位置
lines.en: I was placed wrong during loading.
I dropped and rolled half a turn.
Turn around and there I am.
Not a spawn egg; a glitch.
Half of me is stuck in the wall.
This place used to be tidy.

lines.zh: 我一出现，光就短了一截
lines.en: The light shortened when I arrived.
I have volume but no voice.

lines.zh: 我从你的地基里长出来
lines.en: I grew out of your foundation.
This square is mine to stand in.
I have not found my front side yet.
Do not step on me; I am not aligned.
Look, all six faces move.
Flames warped my edges.
I fell and scattered into pieces.
Water swelled my body.
The blast sent me tumbling.
An arrow wedged into my seam.
The spell turned me the wrong way.
I do not feed; my edges went soft.

lines.zh: 雷击让我六个面一起亮
lines.en: Lightning lit all six faces at once.
The void disassembled my squares.
